optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Software Quality Engineer, Insurance Claims Platform
professionalSummary: Senior QA engineer with three years of experience on a high‑frequency claims‑handling platform, responsible for end‑to‑end release quality, automated regression testing, defect triage, and release documentation.
experienceHighlights: Designed and maintained a Java/Selenium/REST‑assured automated regression suite covering claim intake, reserve changes and payment authorisation flows, running nightly in the CI pipeline.
Reproduced and triaged defects from regression runs and claims operations acceptance sessions, recording root causes in the defect tracker.

Proposed regression scope for each bi‑weekly release during test planning meetings; the QA lead finalized scope and exit criteria, and the candidate’s release test summary served as the quality sign‑off gate.
Authored release test summaries detailing known limitations (e.g., payment flows for reinsured claims) and hand‑over notes for support teams.
Managed regression suite development, defect triage, scope proposals and release documentation as one of four quality engineers on the platform.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Regression suite coverage map and a release test summary with pipeline run identifiers (source: src_4d63cdf17c24).
skills: Automated regression testing (Java, Selenium, REST‑assured), defect triage, test planning, release sign‑off, documentation, CI/CD integration
